dialogue.en: How can we test each concept without showing competing concepts to the same respondent?

after.definition: 每位受访者仅评估一个测试方案的研究设计。
after.example: We will run a monadic test to avoid direct comparisons within respondents.
after.exampleZh: 我们将开展单概念测试，避免同一受访者直接比较多个方案。
